_note: Category-level DemandAdd defaults (lane KK, phase 1 starter). Phase 2 adds per-species / per-plant rows (src/data/demand-items.json) that override these. Rule of thumb, asOf 2026-10-19, ranges deliberately wide.

animals._note: price at refMm total length, scaled by (tl/refMm)^1.2; food USD/month each; mins = care minutes per week each (feeding, watching)

plants._note: by derived difficulty: 0 easy (floaters, epiphytes, low band no CO2), 1 medium, 2 hard (CO2 required or high band). coral by band.
plants.bunchNote: plants of one kind are trimmed in bunches, not one by one: each plant's minutes x (how many of that kind)^-0.35 (assumption: 15 stems take about 40 % of 15 single trims, 144 blades about 18 %)

hardscape._note: price per piece at 150 mm, scaled by (size/150)^1.5

gear._note: class only (no exact models): filter and heater are assumed adequate. perGal is added per interior gallon.

time._note: minutes per week, averaged over the year. waterChange = fixed + perGal x gallons changed; the fraction changed comes from the nitrogen budget (scene/nitrogen.ts waterChangePct), floored and capped here. Lane MW 2026-10-21: intervals cited in research/sourcing/minutes-*.json, every minutes figure is our assumption.

waterChangeFraction._note: floor 10 % a week: American Aquarium Products states 10-20 % weekly, Bulk Reef Supply 10 % weekly (salt); the cap keeps an overstocked tank from asking for more than half the tank a week

testingMin.note: every 2-4 weeks once established (FishyHub), about 6 minutes a run: averaged to a week

yearlyJobsMinPerWeek.note: deep clean, equipment swaps, rescape, divided by 52

feedingTripMinPerWeek.note: one feeding a day (PetMD: once or twice a day), 30 seconds a trip

feederRefillMinPerWeek.note: Eheim drum lasts up to 6 weeks (Jeffers listing); we refill every ~2 weeks, half a minute

glass.note: wipe the glass weekly (Charterhouse); algae grows with light, live plants compete for the nutrients, artificial ones need their own wipe

plantPatchMin.note: a painted patch of live plants (carpet, moss, 3 plants): trimmed every 2-3 weeks (FishyHub); x the growth rate

terrariumAutoMistMin.note: spot clean ~5 min/week plus an automatic mister refill ~5 min every 2 weeks; keeper estimates, no cited figure (research/terrarium-gear.md, lane LT)

terrariumDryMin.note: spot cleaning a terrarium that needs no misting, ~5 min/week; keeper estimate, no cited figure (research/terrarium-gear.md, lane LT)

risk._note: raw points before skill scaling and the 0-10 squash
